|gr1= Camera Control

|descr= Prepares the camera field of view (zoom). The default zoom level is 0.75, 0.01 is the nearest and 2 the furthest zoom value. The angle of the field of view is ''atan(FOV)*2'' radians when in 4:3 aspect ratio. Needs the call of [[camCommitPrepared]] to be conducted.
